name: GVA shared-cache role-switch exactness and Mirror marginal cost, mechanism pilot
scope: Single frozen final attention readout with identical prefix/cache is an exact sharing case; upstream changed states are incompatible. This does NOT demonstrate target-model KV sharing, task NLL, or Mirror-specific compression.
assumptions: all q, V, positional K are finite torch float32
roles differ only by reconstruction matrix/readout m for the safe case; same V/Kpos prefix
no training, no heldout labels, no externally trained checkpoint
native GVA full-M and shared factorized M are strong controls
reconstructing full M on each call is unfused CPU overhead

generator.upstream_change: V_bad = V+0.4*tanh(V @ random_orthogonallike), Kpos_bad=Kpos+0.4*tanh(Kpos), q same

cases.A: explicit materialized K_content versus algebraically absorbed qM^T with shared prefix
cases.B: successive role switches over exact same physically aliased V_cache,Kpos including native precomputed matrix and reconstructed basis-code views
cases.C: counterexample: upstream different V/Kpos during prefill, intentionally incorrect reused previous prefix vs true modified-prefill reference
cases.D: RoPE-valid complex-plane commuting transform and invalid noncommuting shear

baselines: single canonical native GVA cache with full per-role matrices (strong cache control)
single canonical native factorized basis plus task codes (same cost as candidate)
measurements: max score and output error float32
pointer equality/physical untyped_storage nbytes and explicit clone bytes
true logit/output discrepancy for unsafe case
serialized named NPZ inference map bank bytes
CPU per-call P50/P95 native precomposed M vs Mirror recomposition, 20 warmup 100 measured iterations

gates.algebra_PASS: max absolute score error <=3e-5 and context readout output error <=3e-5 over all 5 worlds; pointer identity and no new canonical cache allocation for safe switches
gates.unsafe_PASS: all 5 incompatible changed-prefill worlds yield output discrepancy >1e-4 vs incorrect reuse; unsafe labeled incompatible
gates.Mirror_specific_PASS: candidate improves quality/storage/runtime Pareto versus both native single-cache GVA and native same-basis factorized code, with >=10% actual persistent state saving and <=10% P95 overhead; any exact parity with native code is M0
gates.FAIL: safe algebra error exceeds limits, any invalid clone called physical alias, or unsafe change is misclassified as safe
gates.UNCERTAIN: timing short or changed prefix too small to detect; report exact axes and do not claim statistical capacity proof

inference_accounting.byte_authority: np.savez actual serialized file size with consistent dtype naming
inference_accounting.cache_authority: torch storage nbytes and data_ptr plus explicit cloned scenario
inference_accounting.metadata: same frozen JSON metadata included or disclosed separately
inference_accounting.latency: CPU torch float32, threads=1, batch1, prefix128, warmup20 measure100; GPU not available; clock may vary

hard_boundaries: No natural LM task, no NLL, no trained capacity and no GPU throughput
Native factorized code mathematically matches Mirror when same basis; zero novel functionality
All five fresh worlds must be reported even when FAIL
Existing MA-1162 remains UNTESTED, this is predeclared Stage-0 exploratory research
